palette_intent: 米白和暖浅灰不规则石路为主；淡紫只用于外围屋顶及少量小花，薄荷用于叶片和细缝；暖阳，不使用紫色主地面。

qa.color_sampling_note: Approximate read-only median of warm low-saturation stone pixels, not pixel-identical grading or an acceptance test.
qa.composition: Selected refined plate: reduced perimeter intrusion, left/right lanes open, no interior raised object, no repeating rail stamps, no flat-color band, no gold vertical seam.
qa.visual_check: v3只重绘小石砖密度与地色，外围主要地标与出入口位置保留；生成笔触存在局部变化。四张原图已逐图检查，运行时另检查人物和道具比例。

notes: One opaque 3:2 image integrates ground and all four natural town outskirts; do not add the v1 repeating edge strips over this plate.
World runtime should map its authored arena onto walkable_normalized_rect; surrounding art remains exterior and noncolliding.
Runtime owns all actors, monsters, active beacons, equipment drops and furniture; none are represented as active entities by this plate.
A few tiny fixed lamp-topped exterior garden posts are ambient border decoration only, not interactable beacons; do not assign triggers or duplicate runtime functional devices at those pixels.
Sparse floor moss and petals are flat decorative marks; interior remains continuous walkable ground.
The normalized walkable rectangle is not drawn as a hard border; paving blends across it into the outer village lanes.

placement_normalized_rect maps the authored arena to the nominal painted floor extent; walkable_normalized_polygon supplies the dry-ground boundary independently. Decorative bank props may remain outside the player boundary.
v3重绘内场小石砖，不缩放整张图；保留v2已验证的干地多边形和统一原画/运行时映射。

boundary.authority: painted dry stone curb / root bank / rock verge

runtime_chunks.texture_memory: one shared texture; no streaming claim
